stage1.impression: A clean, legible spectrum line-up whose best idea, the tinted shadows thrown forward onto pale paper, does read, and the yellow, blue and violet pools are genuinely pretty. But it is a flat, frontal catalogue row: the speakers are small, face-on and evenly spaced like a product grid, the cove line slices through the horns, the paper is a featureless white field with a third of the frame empty, and the black horn throats read as holes. It is a competent render, not yet a campaign photograph.

blocking_9: The line must read as a composed arrangement in depth (the arc and the two ranks visible at a glance), not as a flat row of eight face-on copies
The cabinets must read as thick tinted acrylic volumes, with lit edges and a visible side, not as flat coloured panels
No visible wall/floor seam behind the horns: one continuous paper with a smooth falloff
The coloured light on the floor must be the hero: larger, more saturated pools that carry into the lower third, so the frame has no dead empty floor
The paper must read as paper at full size: visible tooth and tonal variation, not a uniform CG plane
Horn throats must hold detail instead of crushing to black blobs

defects.what: Wall/cove/floor seam visible as a darker band (about 223) between the wall (228-234) and the floor (240), running right through the horns
Bottom fifth of the frame is empty floor, lum_range 1.1: no paper texture, no light, dead space
Every horn's compression driver and throat crush to black (crush 20% in the red horn); they read as holes
All eight cabinets face the lens square-on with near-uniform spacing; the 0.7 m staggered ranks and the 0.5 m arc barely register at 13.5 m / 70 mm; reads as a repeated model grid
Green cabinet has a hard black rim on its left side edge, like a CG outline
Smoked cabinet reads as a near-black slab (median 28); its acrylic depth is lost
Body shadows are large grey slabs (lum ~84) that dominate the coloured pools; the colour is a thin strip at the far end of each shadow
Products occupy only about 40% of the frame height and 9% width each; they lack hero scale for a 2:1 homepage banner

changes.problem: The face-on, evenly spaced row reads as a flat catalogue grid of one repeated model; the cabinets read as flat panels instead of thick acrylic volumes.

evidence.measured: all eight fronts rectangular with no visible side; back rank only marginally smaller/higher than the front rank

change.setting: arrangement: turn toward the middle; arc depth; back-rank offset
change.from: 0.0 deg toward the middle; arc middle 0.5 m back; back rank 0.7 m
change.to: 14 deg toward the middle (keep the hand-set jitter); arc middle 1.4 m back; back rank 1.0 m

changes.expected: Each cabinet shows a lit side face and its 20 mm acrylic edge; the line visibly curves away from the lens and the two ranks overlap slightly, giving depth and rhythm instead of a grid.

changes.problem: The speakers are too small and the bottom of the frame is dead floor; the camera height also puts the cove line through the horns.

evidence.measured: lum_range 1.1 over the bottom 140 px; products span y 180-430 only

change.to: (0, -11.0, 1.5), 85 mm, f/5.6, extra shift chosen so the horn tops sit at about 22% from the top and the coloured pools end at about 88%

changes.expected: The line fills about 55% of the frame height, the coloured pools carry into the lower third, the eye level drops toward the product's mid-height for more presence, and the top fifth stays clear for the title.

changes.problem: The coloured light, the whole idea of the picture, is a thin strip at the far end of large grey shadows.

evidence.measured: blue pool r129 g184 b225, lum 175, only about 25 px deep; grey body shadow at (560,420)-(600,440) lum 84 covers most of each footprint

change.to: elevation 18 deg, 36 W/m2, 1.0 deg across; drop over from 3.0 to 2.0 W/m2 so the pools gain saturation against the paper

changes.expected: Shadows stretch about 1.8x toward the lens, each horn's colour pool roughly doubles in depth and sits in the lower third, crisper and more saturated.

changes.problem: A darker cove band and a brightness step between wall and floor draw a seam right through the horns.

evidence.measured: vertical profile 234 / 228 / 223 / 242: a dip of about 19 levels at the cove then a jump onto the floor

change.from: cyc 21.0 W/m2 centred 2.0 m up; top 4.0 W/m2 over y = 7.0
change.to: cyc 24 W/m2 centred 1.2 m up (so it fills the cove); top 5.5 W/m2 moved to y = 10.0 over the cove

changes.expected: A continuous sweep with the wall falling smoothly to the floor, no band behind the horns.

changes.problem: The horn throats and compression drivers crush to black and read as holes in every horn.

evidence.measured: crush_pct 20.75, lum_p5 0.0 in the red horn

change.to: 9 x 0.8 m at (0, -5, 1.9), 110 W/m2, still linked to the drivers only

changes.expected: The phase plug, rim and throat show form and a soft highlight; the horn reads as a horn, not a hole.

changes.problem: The paper is a uniform plane with no tooth, which says render at full size.

change.to: tooth 3.5 at 1.2 mm, colour mottle 0.12, #ECE9E3 (a touch warmer and less white so it sits under the white point)

changes.expected: Under the low grazing key the paper shows a fine tooth and a gentle tonal drift, like real seamless paper, without visible repetition.

changes.problem: The smoked cabinet reads as a near-black slab and loses its acrylic depth next to the bright ones.
changes.expected: The smoked cabinet shows its ribs, lining and ring through a dark glassy tone, with a clear edge highlight.

changes.problem: The green cabinet has a hard black rim along its left edge that reads as a CG outline.

change.to: 1.2 x 3 m at (-6, -3, 1.4), 18 W/m2, so the side edges mirror a lit strip instead of the dark set

changes.expected: Cabinet side edges read as bright glassy edges rather than black outlines once the cabinets are turned (c1).

out_of_scope.request: Less opaque lining (or a lighter batt layout) so more of each cabinet's colour reaches the floor
out_of_scope.why: The batts and their opacity are part of the fixed speaker; the grey body shadows they cause can only be managed through light and camera.

out_of_scope.request: A lighter finish on the compression driver housing
out_of_scope.why: The driver is a part of the speaker; only its lighting is ours to change.
